sections.heading: DSNG.JK — Dharma Satya Nusantara
sections.markdown:
**Signal / why now:** #2 INDO NEGLECTED at IDR 1,330 (−28.9% off the 52w high; mom6 −18.5%) and a kill_ledger revisit — killed 07-13 on valuation (@1,180) and 08-19 on liquidity (@1,360), so entry is 2.2% BELOW the second kill price. The fresh dossier is the hook: FY2025 net income +61.1% to IDR 1,840.5bn on revenue +21.7%, ROE 16.0%, net debt/EBITDA 1.18x (from 3.26x), and Q2-2026 net income of IDR 571.0bn — the strongest quarter in the series — into B40-supported CPO.

**Archetype:** commodity_capex_turnaround (rate 0.42, up +75%, down −35%, 3y). Method card: VAL_COMMODITY_CYCLICAL. EV = +11.2%. Cross-archetype: dividend_income_anchor — payout only 13.8% on a 16.0% ROE, so capacity is unexercised.

**3 questions a deep-dive must answer:**
1. Is the 08-19 liquidity kill binding? ADV is ~IDR 6.3bn/day (~$350k) — can a book-sized line enter and exit without moving the price, or is a watchlist liquidity trigger the right home?
2. Is the 7.7x entry sitting on peak CPO margins — the registry's named incentive-price trap — or mid-cycle, given B40 absorbs 2–3mt of supply annually?
3. What is DSNG's cost of production versus the CPO price at which B40 support breaks?

**Fast-disqualify:** EV positive ✓ (+11.2%). Valuation anchor ✓/⚠ — 7.7x FY2025 EPS (IDR 173.63), ~7.0x on the H1-2026 run-rate; +75% implies ~13.5x, above where the liquid AALI trades (~11.0x), so the up-leg is not free. Primary sources reachable ✓. **WATCH, not ADVANCE: the 08-19 liquidity kill is unrebutted.**
